title: National Library of Chile
geometryBasis: Native named relation 6123552 with a 55-point footprint and three nested light wells, projected from the Alameda front. Entrance bay and roof pavilions follow the verified archival evidence of the standing library.
sectionBasis: The restored public entrance meets the original approach terrain. The two main floors, rusticated base and attic are estimated from the mapped 68 m Alameda face and the verified views. The existing city elevation is preserved, and perimeter foundations follow it locally.
limitations: The standing library includes the main Alameda pavilion and as-built wings with the mapped light wells. The adjoining separately mapped Archivo Nacional and its original, partially unbuilt proposals remain outside the library geometry.

The contemporary footprint sets the horizontal envelope. Original archive views and published architectural descriptions control the entrance bay, roofs and major facades. Exact facade and roof heights, window frames, roof colors and minor ornament are estimates.
Alameda entrance grade follows the frozen open elevation field. The source also preserves the slope toward Cerro Santa Lucía and urban height artifacts. Rear and courtyard grades are approximate.
